items.title: Tony D'Angelo Details Pressure of Being NXT Champion
items.summary: Former WWE NXT Champion Tony D'Angelo explained on the Battleground Podcast that the titleholder carries major responsibility for the brand's television ratings. He said the champion is the face of the show handling media and commercials, adding that blame falls on them if numbers are poor. D'Angelo is scheduled to challenge for the title against Grayson Waller at NXT Halloween Havoc.
items.raw_title: Tony D’Angelo says WWE NXT champion faces pressure over television ratings
items.src_summary: Former champion Tony D’Angelo recently revealed the amount of responsibility that the WWE NXT Champion has regarding TV ratings. Recently, speaking on the Battleground Podcast, D’Angelo opened up about the responsibilities of a WWE NXT Champion. “A lot comes with it.

kind.quote: A lot comes with it. You’re the guy. The brand is on your shoulders. You’re at the forefront of everything, commercials, media, all this stuff. And it’s a lot more stressful because, I’m trying to be PC here, but crap rolls downhill.

updates.line: Tony D'Angelo explained the heavy responsibilities that come with holding the NXT Championship after winning the title earlier this year.

items.title: Billy Gunn Discusses His Sons Austin And Colten

items.title: Tony D'Angelo Not Focused On NXT Legacy
items.summary: Tony D'Angelo, a multi-year WWE NXT veteran who rose during the 2.0 era and is a current Grand Slam Champion, is scheduled to challenge for the NXT Championship at Halloween Havoc in 2026. In a recent interview with Love Wrestling, he said he avoids thinking about whether he will be viewed as one of the all-time greats in NXT and instead focuses on working hard. D'Angelo added that it would be great if fans eventually see him as a pillar of the brand but he is not preoccupied with that idea.
items.raw_title: Tony D'Angelo Says He 'Isn't Too Focused' On Being Considered One Of The All-Time Greats In WWE NXT
items.src_summary: Tony D'Angelo says that he 'isn't too focused' on being considered one of the all-time greats in WWE NXT. D'Angelo has been a part of NXT for several years now, breaking out onto the brand during the 2.0 era of the developmental brand.

kind.quote: I try not to think of it, honestly. I’m just trying to keep my nose to the grindstone, and you know what? At the end of the day, if people want to say I’m one of the pillars or people held of high standard when it comes to NXT and championships and all that, then that would be awesome, and more power to me and my family and what I’ve done. But honestly, I’m not too focused on that.

items.title: Samoa Joe Praises Modern Wrestlers' Adaptability
items.summary: Samoa Joe recently returned to AEW after filming for "Twisted Metal." In February 2025 he formed the Opps faction and has been working to elevate talents including Hook and Katsuyori Shibata. Speaking on SHAK Wrestling about the current generation such as Hook and Action Andretti, Joe said today's wrestlers show better adaptability and coordination than those from his era or earlier generations, noting many possess strong natural aptitude even if they have less physical potential, a trend he compared to lighter weight classes in MMA.

kind.quote: I think adaptability and coordination are way better than they've probably been in years.

items.title: Ric Flair Explains His Remarkable Longevity

items.title: Paul Heyman Says Roman Reigns Was The Only Choice After Brock Lesnar

items.title: Sunny Sytch Seeks to Vacate DUI Manslaughter Conviction
items.summary: WWE Hall of Famer Tammy Sytch, serving a prison term until December 2038, filed a motion this month to have her 2023 conviction thrown out. Per PWInsider, Sytch claims her defense provided ineffective counsel by failing to investigate Julian LaFrancis Lasseter's pre-existing medical conditions such as coronary artery disease and stenosis that contributed to his death in the March 2022 Florida traffic accident. The filing also references toxicology results showing Lasseter had Adderall and Cialis in his system at the time.

items.title: LJ Cleary Out 9-12 Months With Injury
items.summary: Top independent wrestler LJ Cleary announced he will undergo surgery and miss 9-12 months of action. The 27-year-old from Ireland had been enjoying the strongest year of his career with recent appearances for ROH and TNA, including the Call Your Shot gauntlet at Bound for Glory, plus prior work for NJPW, Pro Wrestling NOAH and a 2025 WWE tryout. His earliest possible return is summer 2027, per the Wrestling Observer.

items.title: Judge Rejects Tammy Sytch Bid to Review 17-Year Sentence
items.summary: Tammy Sytch filed a motion in Volusia County seeking review of her conviction and 17-year prison sentence for the 2022 death of Julian Lasseter. She pleaded no contest to charges including DUI manslaughter, driving with a suspended license, and property damage after striking the 75-year-old with her vehicle while having a blood-alcohol level more than three times the legal limit. The judge has dismissed the motion, which cited failure to investigate causation and conflict along with omitted and new evidence regarding Lasseter's pre-existing medical conditions.

items.title: Maria Kanellis Finds New Path After AEW Exit
items.summary: Former WWE, AEW and ROH performer Maria Kanellis has stepped away from wrestling since leaving AEW in January 2023. She now works as an event planner and florist in Nashville while raising her children and focusing on her health after battles with a tumor and skin cancer. In a recent interview, Kanellis discussed the period of self-reflection that followed her departure and how her husband supported her while she decided on her next steps.
items.raw_title: Former WWE/AEW Star Maria Kanellis Ruminates On Future
items.src_summary: Former WWE and AEW star Maria Kanellis ruminated on her future and a possible return to the wrestling industry.

kind.quote: Because I was in AEW and I was in ROH and I had a tumor and I had skin cancer and I had this and I had that. So, it was a lot of self-reflection. Luckily, I have a husband that's just allowed me to take my time to figure out, 'What do I want to do next?'

items.title: Grayson Waller Shares AJ Styles' Social Media Advice
items.summary: Grayson Waller recalled on Stephanie McMahon's What's Your Story podcast that years ago AJ Styles advised him to ignore both positive and negative social media comments after matches. Styles said the only opinions that matter come from Triple H, Shawn Michaels and Matt Bloom because of their experience and ability to book wrestlers. Waller noted it remains difficult for current talent to avoid checking feedback despite the advice.
items.raw_title: Grayson Waller Recalls AJ Styles Giving The Advice To Not Worry About Social Media Feedback
items.src_summary: Grayson Waller weighs in on social media. Wrestlers are more prevalent than ever on social media, whether they are just checking what is being said or replying to anyone and everyone.

kind.quote: If there is a mean comment about you online, it doesn’t matter. If there is a good comment about you online, it doesn’t matter. Any opinion that matters at any point: Hunter, Shawn, Bloom.

items.title: WWE NXT Rating And Viewership Drop From Last Week
items.summary: Tuesday's episode of WWE NXT drew a 0.09 rating in the 18-49 demographic and 520,000 viewers according to Wrestlenomics. items.title: Stardom Continues Weekday Big Event Tests
items.summary: Stardom President Taro Okada plans to keep experimenting with staging major shows on weekdays to reach fans unavailable on weekends. The October 29 event at Ota City General Gymnasium in Tokyo drew an announced attendance of 1,994, headlined by Suzu Suzuki retaining the World of Stardom Championship against Starlight Kid, narrowly missing the 2,000-fan target. Okada noted positive feedback from weekday attendees and stressed that filling those shows is necessary to grow the promotion and meet varied customer needs.

The 6'2", 285-pound Lesnar left a multimillion-dollar WWE contract that year to pursue an NFL roster spot with Minnesota.

She cited examples like a blood-covered Skye Blue, Julia Hart misting opponents, and herself using a belt to punish a referee.

kind.quote: I do think that. Women have, for a very long time, tried to make up for a lack of technique and stamina in the ring. We just have to get a little bit more insane. Just come up with crazy shit that we can do to humiliate each other, use psychological warfare and weapons, whether it’s a crazy happy Skye Blue covered in blood or if it’s Julia Hart misting left and right, or if it’s me getting out my belt and starting to punish the referee.

items.title: Ex-WWE Exec Recalls Tense Saudi Deal Trip
items.summary: Former WWE executive George Barrios was dispatched to Riyadh to finalize the company's deal with Saudi Arabia because Vince McMahon declined to travel and co-president Michelle Wilson stayed home due to her gender adding complications at the time. Barrios admitted feeling worried despite his self-described tough background, with his wife Carol also concerned, especially as the trip occurred weeks after the widely reported death of journalist Jamal Khashoggi. The story, shared on a podcast with Jeff Jarrett and Conrad Thompson, includes details of a Saudi prince in his underwear, hookah, and armed guards during the negotiations.

items.title: Amazing Red Eyes Potential X Division Match With AJ Styles' Son
items.summary: In an interview with SportsMattersTV, Amazing Red discussed the possibility of AJ Styles coming out of retirement and also addressed the long-term prospect of one day facing Styles' son Avery for the X Division Championship. Red noted that Styles appears deeply involved in training and supporting his son's wrestling path, emphasizing how difficult it is for wrestlers to fully step away from the business. He compared wrestling to an ex-girlfriend that won't leave you alone, referencing how Will Ospreay pulled him out of retirement.

kind.quote: I feel like, just cause I’ve been thinking that also, and the way Will Ospreay took me out of retirement and just kept pushing me, and then I kind of came back.

items.title: Callum Newman Criticizes AEW Stars' NJPW Approach
items.summary: Former IWGP Heavyweight Champion Callum Newman expressed frustration with AEW wrestlers who view NJPW as an easy opportunity to make a name for themselves simply because of their AEW background. He noted that many only appear for single shows without experiencing full tours or the demanding daily dojo training and travel schedule required in New Japan. Newman made the comments in an interview with NJPW, as Kenny Omega, Jon Moxley, MJF and Will Ospreay have been building toward matches at Wrestle Kingdom 21.
items.raw_title: Callum Newman: AEW Wrestlers Feel NJPW Is Easy, It's Not Easy
items.src_summary: AEW seems set to have a big presence at NJPW Wrestle Kingdom 21 with Kenny Omega, Jon Moxley, MJF, and Will Ospreay all appearing on recent NJPW shows to set up future NJPW matches. This doesn't sit well with former IWGP Heavyweight Champion Callum Newman.

kind.quote: I’m not salty about them, I just feel angry because when their wrestlers want to make a name for themselves in Japan, they feel NJPW is an easy in for them just because they have AEW on their resume.

items.title: Callum Newman Claims Leadership Of United Empire
items.summary: After Will Ospreay departed NJPW for AEW in February 2024, Callum Newman says he stepped up to lead United Empire when no one else would, sacrificing heavily and representing the group in every match. Newman notes that TJP had previously filled the role after Ospreay, but following further departures and injuries to HENARE and Akira, he took charge and reshaped the stable while adding Jake Lee and Andrade El Idolo. Ospreay later created a United States version of the group after winning the AEW World Championship.
items.raw_title: Callum Newman: I Stepped Up To Lead United Empire When Nobody Did, Then Will Ospreay Makes In Own Group In The US
items.src_summary: When Will Ospreay left NJPW in February 2024 to officially join AEW, United Empire was left without a leader. Eventually, Callum Newman took the throne, shaping the group in his vision and ascending to the top of NJPW.

kind.quote: I said to them, to their faces, somebody has to do something or this group is going to go downhill.

items.title: Callum Newman Reveals Shoulder Pop During G1 Match With Aaron Wolf
items.summary: Callum Newman entered the G1 Climax tournament with a dislocated shoulder sustained at NJPW Dominion. During his bout against Aaron Wolf, he felt his shoulder pop and move after a judo throw, sending an electric sensation down his arm, before going on to reach the semifinals. He lost to Ryohei Oiwa in the semifinals after also being put through a table in a prior match.
items.raw_title: Callum Newman Says His Shoulder 'Popped' In G1 Bout Against Aaron Wolf
items.src_summary: Callum Newman suffered a shoulder injury at NJPW Dominion, going into the annual G1 Climax tournament with what he said was a dislocated shoulder. Newman still competed in every match of the tournament, making it to the semifinals before losing to Ryohei Oiwa.

kind.quote: He gave me one of those judo throws and it popped- not popped out but I felt it move and then I felt this bolt of electricity down my arm.

items.title: JBL Explains Why John Cena Never Turned Heel
items.summary: JBL discussed the repeated pitches to turn John Cena heel throughout his career. Vince McMahon refused every time because he had previously tried turning Stone Cold Steve Austin heel at the peak of his popularity and it failed to work. Cena accounted for 50 to 60 percent of merchandise sales and remained a babyface as a result.
items.raw_title: JBL Says John Cena Had the Hardest Job of Any Champion in Wrestling History

kind.quote: I don’t think there was a right time, and I think one of the reasons was because we tried that with Steve. We tried that with Stone Cold and he was so freaking popular, and he was selling all the merch. When do you turn a hot babyface heel? When they’re the hottest. It just didn’t work with Steve, and I think Vince took that and thought, ‘I’m not going to make the same mistake with John.’

items.title: HAYATA Tears ACL at NOAH Wrestle Odyssey II
items.summary: During his GHC Junior Heavyweight Championship defense against Shuji Kondo at Pro Wrestling NOAH's Wrestle Odyssey II, HAYATA was knocked off the apron and landed back-first on the guardrail. He immediately clutched his left knee and was unable to return to the ring before the referee's count. Per the promotion, HAYATA has suffered a torn ACL in his left knee and has been removed from the 2026 NOAH Junior Grand Prix tournament.

items.summary: Stephanie Vaquer was not medically cleared to wrestle on Monday's Raw. Adam Pearce still booked Liv Morgan to defend the Women's World Championship against Becky Lynch in the main event. Lynch appeared set to win with a Manhandle Slam before Raquel Rodriguez and Roxanne Perez caused a disqualification; Stratton then tried to cash in her Money in the Bank briefcase on Morgan only for Dominik Mysterio to intervene.

items.title: Liv Morgan Retains Women's World Title On WWE Raw
items.summary: Becky Lynch stepped in as the last-minute challenger for Liv Morgan's WWE Women's World Championship on the October 26 episode of Raw after Stephanie Vaquer was not medically cleared. The back-and-forth main event ended in disqualification when Roxanne Perez and Raquel Rodriguez interfered on Morgan's behalf, allowing The Judgment Day to disrupt the match. Lynch had Morgan trapped in a second Disarmher before the interference occurred.

The episode closed with another cash-in tease following the chaotic finish.

items.title: Kaitlyn Has No Desire To Return To The Ring
items.summary: Former WWE Divas Champion Kaitlyn told Insight With Chris Van Vliet that she plans to stay retired from in-ring competition. She expressed respect for wrestling and appreciation for its artistry but stated she does not want to get back in the ring. Kaitlyn noted that her experience as a wrestler gave her a deeper understanding of match psychology, storytelling, performer safety and other performance aspects.

items.title: WWE Not Planning Sphere As WrestleMania 43 Backup
items.summary: WWE is scheduled to hold WrestleMania 43 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in April 2027, marking the first time the event takes place outside North America. Per Fightful Select, there are no plans to use The Sphere in Las Vegas as a backup venue despite recent speculation. The Sphere already has John Mayer shows booked on the targeted April 10-11 dates plus later in the month, along with Oprah Winfrey appearances from April 2-4.
items.raw_title: No Indication That WWE Is Planning To Use The Sphere As Backup WrestleMania 43 Venue
items.src_summary: WWE is not planning for The Sphere to be a backup venue. In April 2027, WWE is going to present its biggest show of the year, WrestleMania, in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

items.title: Sami Zayn Explains Avoiding Social Media Tribute To PAC
items.summary: WWE Undisputed Champion Sami Zayn told Chris Van Vliet he could not bring himself to post about the death of Benjamin "PAC" Satterly last month. Zayn described PAC as a brother he traveled the world and grew up with in the business, saying the depth of their bond could not be properly expressed in a tweet or Instagram post. A video tribute featuring WWE talent was assembled by Kevin Owens while AEW and other promotions paid their respects.
items.raw_title: WWE's Sami Zayn Explains Why He Didn't Post Anything About The Death Of AEW Star Pac
items.src_summary: The wrestling world was rocked by the death of Benjamin "PAC" Satterly last month. His good friend, WWE's Sami Zayn explains why he didn't post to social media.

kind.quote: I wasn't able to post anything, I haven't posted anything (pauses) because what do you even say in a tweet, you know what I mean? 'Hey, here's this guy that was like a brother to me, that I traveled the world with, that I grew up with'. Like this bond, it's hard to articulate what these bonds mean. And then I'm supposed to do it in a tweet or like an Instagram post with 10 pictures out of the hundreds of thou – you know what I mean? None of it will do it justice.

TMZ initially described her as an AEW and NXT wrestler, though she only appeared in enhancement matches for those promotions years ago and was never under contract with either.

items.summary: Following his bout with Luke Jacobs at PROGRESS Chapter 199, Eddie Kingston delivered a heartfelt promo reflecting on the recent deaths of The Butcher and PAC. He revealed that he did not leave his house for five days afterward and considered exiting the wrestling business before crediting fan messages about mental health for helping him continue. items.title: Sol Ruca Overcomes Imposter Syndrome On WWE Main Roster
items.summary: Sol Ruca arrived on the WWE main roster in April 2026 after her time as NXT Women’s North American Champion. She soon captured the women’s Intercontinental Championship and has been a regular in the Monday Night RAW women’s division. In an interview with the Fresno Bee, she discussed feeling imposter syndrome as an athlete before realizing she belongs and is passionate about her current path.
items.raw_title: Sol Ruca: Especially As An Athlete, I Feel Like A Lot Of Us Have A Bit Of Imposter Syndrome

kind.quote: Especially as an athlete, I feel like a lot of us have a bit of imposter syndrome, thinking, ‘I don’t know if this is right for me. This isn’t something I was passionate about when I was a little kid.’ But now I’m passionate about it, and that was definitely a bit of reassurance that this is where I’m supposed to be, I’m in the right place, and this is something I want to continue doing.

items.title: Rey Pegasus Still Processing CMLL Middleweight Title Win
items.summary: Rey Pegasus earned a shot at the CMLL Mexican National Middleweight Title through fan voting and defeated Guerrero Maya Jr. at Noche de Campeones to capture the championship. In an interview with Fightful, he admitted that weeks later he still cannot fully process the victory, especially given the strong competition in the vote that included Blue Panther and Brillante Jr. Pegasus described the fan support and the title match itself as historic moments in his young career.
items.raw_title: Rey Pegasus Says He Still Hasn't Fully Processed Winning CMLL Mexican National Middleweight Title
items.src_summary: Rey Pegasus comments on winning the Mexican National Middleweight Title. Rey Pegasus became the challenger for the Mexican National Middleweight Title via online fan voting. He faced then-champion Guerrero Maya Jr.

kind.quote: Come to think of it, several weeks have already gone by, and I still can’t wrap my head around it.

items.summary: The Rock's recent video tribute to the late PAC, where he called Tony Khan a friend and described AEW as a growing phenomenal wrestling company, continues to be a topic of conversation within WWE weeks later. items.summary: Cody Rhodes admitted he has caught the acting bug after receiving strong reviews for his role as Guile in Street Fighter. The American Nightmare told Rich Eisen that wrestling is his whole life and will stay his day job. He cited the paths cleared by Dave Batista, John Cena and The Rock as reasons wrestlers now get opportunities in Hollywood.

He expressed deep disappointment on social media, apologizing to all involved and noting how much he was looking forward to the trip.

items.src_summary: 1 Called Manders cancels his scheduled RevPro appearances due to injury. On social media, the wrestler informed fans that he suffered an injury while wrestling in a match in Boston on October 24 due to which he won’t be able to make it to RevPro’s October 25 show.

items.title: Tatum Paxley Calls Alexa Bliss Huge Inspiration
items.summary: Tatum Paxley revealed that Alexa Bliss inspired her to enter pro wrestling. The pair first met in a WWE Women's Tag Team Title match at NXT Homecoming in 2025 before Paxley aligned with Bliss and Charlotte Flair on her main roster debut less than a year later. Paxley now views both women as key mentors while adjusting to life on the WWE SmackDown roster.
items.raw_title: Tatum Paxley Discusses WWE Main Roster Mentor

kind.quote: Alexa Bliss has been a huge inspiration for me. She was the one that got me interested in pro wrestling and the one that kind of opened my eyes to seeing their story to be told here. She was a huge inspiration, so to be working alongside her now, there's no word for it. It's insane.

items.title: Jonathan Gresham Open To ROH Return Under Tony Khan
items.summary: Jonathan Gresham revealed he has repeatedly reached out to apologize in person to AEW President Tony Khan during visits to Atlanta but has been turned down. The former ROH World and Pure Champion, who asked for and received his release from ROH in July 2022 after a pre-match dispute involving dropping the title to Claudio Castagnoli at Death Before Dishonor, said he and Khan have not spoken since. Gresham expressed hope that they can eventually settle their differences so he can return to Ring of Honor.
items.raw_title: Jonathan Gresham Comments On Chances Of Returning Work For ROH Under AEW's Tony Khan
items.src_summary: Jonathan Gresham comments on if he would ever like to return to ROH, should the opportunity present itself.

kind.quote: I'm never going to say never, but I've reached out several times to apologize in person when they've come here to Atlanta...I'm just going to say 'no' was the answer that I got. And that's fair.

items.title: Drew McIntyre Ranks His HIAC With CM Punk Among WWE's Best
items.summary: Drew McIntyre stated that from a story and match standpoint his 2024 Hell in a Cell bout against CM Punk at Bad Blood ranks as one or two alongside the inaugural 1997 Hell in a Cell between The Undertaker and Shawn Michaels. McIntyre emphasized the personal hatred between himself and Punk that elevated the contest and claimed he ultimately lost due to blood loss rather than being beaten by Punk. He noted receiving 17 staples in his head following the match.
items.raw_title: Drew McIntyre Believes WWE's Best Hell In A Cell Match Comes Down To His & One Other
items.src_summary: According to Drew McIntyre, there is only one other Hell in a Cell match that might surpass he and CM Punk at WWE Bad Blood 2024.

kind.quote: From a story perspective, from a match perspective, I'll argue all day: it's one and two between us and 'Taker and Shawn, the first ever Hell in a Cell.

items.title: Kofi Reflects On KofiMania As Childhood Dream
items.summary: In 2019, Kofi won the WWE Championship by defeating Bryan Danielson at WrestleMania 35, marking the peak of the fan-supported KofiMania movement that pushed WWE to create a title run they had not originally planned. The period remains one of the most memorable in recent WWE history despite the reign ending quickly. Speaking on The Mick and Kenny Show, Kofi recalled how the experience felt perfect each week at work while noting it came at the expense of Mustafa Ali's injury, wondering if it might have led to MustafaMania instead.
items.raw_title: AEW Star Kofi Looks Back On Kofi-Mania In WWE: 'Childhood Dream Come True'
items.src_summary: AEW's Kofi recently reflected on historic KofiMana run that led to him becoming WWE Champion at WrestleMania 35 and what it meant to him.

kind.quote: It felt great because winning the WWE Championship was a childhood dream come true.

items.title: Penta Praises Roman Reigns After Mexico City Loss
items.summary: Penta faced Roman Reigns in the main event of WWE Raw in Mexico City on September 14. In an interview with Busted Open Radio, he reflected on the experience and explained why he now understands Reigns is one of the best in the business. Penta expressed gratitude to WWE, his fans, and life for the special moment in his home country.
items.raw_title: Penta Looks Back On Challenging Roman Reigns For WWE World Heavyweight Title
items.src_summary: WWE star Penta raves about his opportunity to challenge Roman Reigns for the company's World Heavyweight Championship.

kind.quote: I learned a lot facing Roman Reigns because, to be honest, I know now why he is one of the best wrestlers, or the best wrestler in the universe.

items.title: Rey Pegasus Finds Los Amos del Aire Role Rewarding
items.summary: Rey Pegasus discussed his experience in the CMLL stable Los Amos del Aire alongside Tornado and trainer Magia Blanca. He described the setup as very rewarding since his former teacher is now a group mate who continues offering guidance and support. Pegasus noted the trio works closely to deliver strong performances for fans and expressed happiness at how quickly CMLL developed the concept.
items.raw_title: Rey Pegasus Says Being In Los Amos del Aire With Magia Blanca Is ‘Very Rewarding’
items.src_summary: Rey Pegasus comments on Los Amos del Aire. Los Amos del Aire is a stable in CMLL that consists of Rey Pegasus, Tornado, and Magia Blanca (trainer). Speaking with Fightful’s Luis Pulido, Pegasus talked about being a member of this group.

kind.quote: It’s very rewarding. The fact that your teacher is now your classmate is really great because, while he was already sharing his knowledge with us in the classes he taught at school, now, as classmates, he’s always attentive, always supporting us, and always helping us prepare even more because he knows the responsibility that comes with this after having been a teacher who’s been with CMLL for many years.

items.title: JBL Praises WWE's AAA Integration
items.summary: John "Bradshaw" Layfield stated on "Something To Wrestle" that WWE's acquisition of Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide represents the company's first successful integration of another promotion. JBL noted that AAA has kept its core identity while occasionally overlapping with WWE programming. He explained that past efforts with WCW and ECW struggled because of Vince McMahon's mindset from competing against the territories.
items.raw_title: JBL Believes AAA Is WWE's First Successful 'Integration' Of Another Promotion
items.src_summary: According to JBL, WWE's acquisition of AAA has been the first time the larger promotion has successfully brought another wrestling company into the fold.

kind.quote: WWE never did an integration very well. The first integration that they have done well, by the way, is AAA.

items.title: Booker T Defied WWE Locker Room Nap Warning
items.summary: Booker T recalled on his Hall of Fame podcast that a fellow wrestler warned him against napping in the WWE locker room because it could draw heat from others. He chose to test the unwritten rule by informing Jim Ross, who had signed his contract, that he planned to nap in his car anyway. Booker noted that no one ever explained the reason behind the prohibition and he refused to alter his pre-match routine.
items.raw_title: Booker T explains why he refused to stop napping backstage in WWE
items.src_summary: Booker T says he was warned that taking naps backstage in WWE could get him heat with other wrestlers, but he refused to change his routine. Speaking on his Hall of Fame podcast, Booker recalled how another wrestler warned him against sleeping in the locker room.

kind.quote: I wouldn’t do that around here if I was you.

items.title: Jerry Lynn Reveals Cornette Wanted Him For The Brood
items.summary: Jerry Lynn disclosed that Jim Cornette tried to recruit him to WWF in the late 1990s to lead the stable that became The Brood. Cornette ultimately passed on Lynn because of his size in an era dominated by bigger wrestlers. Gangrel ended up filling the role alongside Edge and Christian, with the group forming in late 1998.
items.raw_title: Jerry Lynn Says Jim Cornette Pitched Him On Leading WWE Attitude Era Faction
items.src_summary: According to Jerry Lynn, Jim Cornette once tried to bring him into WWE to lead a faction that featured some very prominent wrestlers.

kind.quote: Jim was trying to bring me in — it's funny — he was trying to bring me into WWF to be in The Brood before they brought in Gangrel, but I was too small.

items.title: AJ Francis Recalls Backstage Heat Over Celebrity Fan Choice
items.summary: AJ Francis says he got some backstage heat during his WWE tenure when celebrity guest Expressions, now his TNA tag partner, specifically asked to meet him instead of bigger names like Brock Lesnar or Randy Orton ahead of Money in the Bank 2023 in London. Francis, who performed as Top Dolla at the time, noted that people questioned the request and he felt he became a victim of his own success. He contrasted the situation with his current role in TNA where he feels he has better chances to showcase his talents.
items.raw_title: AJ Francis says he got backstage heat in WWE after celebrity fan chose him over Brock Lesnar
items.src_summary: AJ Francis says he received backstage heat during his WWE run after a celebrity guest wanted to meet him instead of Brock Lesnar or Randy Orton.

kind.quote: When I was in WWE, sometimes you become a victim of your own success. Expressions, who’s with me now in TNA, I remember one time I got a little bit of heat in WWE because when Expressions was backstage as a celebrity fan before Money in the Bank in London, they asked him who did he want to see.

items.title: Eric Bischoff Calls For Soap Opera Style In Wrestling
items.summary: WWE Hall of Famer Eric Bischoff argued that pro wrestling must embrace a soap opera feel to succeed as episodic television. He said stories need to create anticipation so fans are eager for the next episode to see what happens next. Bischoff previously praised Triple H and Bruce Prichard for regaining WWE audience interest after Vince McMahon lost them with his approach to storytelling.
items.raw_title: WWE HOFer Eric Bischoff Explains Necessity Of 'Episodic' Storytelling In Wrestling
items.src_summary: According to Eric Bischoff, the key to successful pro wrestling storytelling is to draw from soap operas.

kind.quote: It is a male, testosterone — and sometimes female — testosterone-driven, action-driven, combat — it's fake combat, but perceived combat — but I think it has to have that soap opera feel in order to be episodic.

items.title: Leon Slater Hopes For TNA Six-Sided Ring Return
items.summary: Leon Slater expressed his desire to wrestle in TNA's six-sided ring as the TNA World Champion. The British star, a longtime TNA fan, discussed the unique ring on the I Love Wrestling Podcast while reacting to the return of Destination X. He noted the six-sided ring was originally used from TNA's debut until 2010, revived in 2014 and retired again in 2018.
items.raw_title: Leon Slater Says He Would Love To Compete In TNA's Six-Sided Ring As TNA World Champion
items.src_summary: Leon Slater says he’d love to compete in a six-sided ring in TNA. When TNA first made its debut, they didn’t use the traditional four-sided ring but rather a six-sided wrestling ring, which was used until 2010. They later brought it back in 2014 but ultimately retired it again in 2018.

kind.quote: I would love the chance to be TNA World Champion and wrestle in a TNA six-sided ring.

updates.line: The latest: the latest: Leon Slater is slated to defend the TNA World Title at Destination X, and he hopes the six-sided ring returns for the show.
updates.title: Comeback Watch: Leon Slater Hopes Six-Sided Ring Returns At TNA Destination X

updates.line: He made it clear he has no inside information about whether the six-sided ring is actually coming back.
updates.title: Leon Slater Wants TNA to Bring Back Six-Sided Ring for Destination X

items.title: Anthony Bowens Recalls Signing With AEW
items.summary: Anthony Bowens discussed his early independent wrestling days before receiving a tryout with All Elite Wrestling in September 2020. He signed with AEW the following month after feeling the promotion offered a better fit for younger talent seeking creative freedom compared to WWE. Weeks after his debut on AEW Dark, Bowens teamed with Max Caster to create The Acclaimed.

items.title: Marc Summers Says WWE Tried To Hire Him As Announcer
items.summary: Marc Summers recalled that during the original run of Double Dare on Nickelodeon the show featured two Super-Slop-a-Mania episodes with WWF stars. Summers said his favorite was the one featuring Gorilla Monsoon against Bobby Heenan and that WWE wanted to hire him away from Nickelodeon to work as an announcer. He turned down the offer because it paid zero money; Summers already knew Heenan from his teenage days selling refreshments together at Starlight Musicals in Indianapolis.
items.raw_title: Legendary TV Host Marc Summers Recalls WWE Trying To Hire Him Away From Nickelodeon
items.src_summary: Legendary TV host Marc Summers recalled the then-WWF attempting to hire him away from Nickelodeon during his "Double Dare" days.

kind.quote: WWE back in the day wanted to hire me away from Nickelodeon and put me on as an announcer on that show, but they offered me zero money, so I wasn't going to do it.

items.summary: On this week's AEW Collision, Jay White appeared with members of The Dogs and the Bang Bang Gang. items.title: Billy Gunn Recalls Unexpected AEW In-Ring Run
items.summary: Billy Gunn signed with AEW expecting to wrestle only about a dozen times per year while also working backstage. Instead he ended up competing frequently on both shows and capturing the AEW World Trios Championship with The Acclaimed as part of his "Daddy Ass" persona. On Inside The Ropes, Gunn said he was surprised by the career resurgence in his late 50s and early 60s but credited staying in shape for his ability to keep up with much younger opponents.
items.raw_title: Billy Gunn Says He Wrestled Much More Than Expected In AEW
items.src_summary: When Billy Gunn started with AEW, he expected to mainly be a coach while wrestling a handful of matches each year, but that quickly expanded.

kind.quote: Yeah, so my contract, I had 12 dates a year. Like, I really wasn't gonna wrestle, but I told Tony [Khan], 'If you need me to, I'll do some here and here and there.'

items.title: Sami Zayn Opens Smackdown With Family Warning
items.summary: On the October 23, 2026 episode of WWE Smackdown from the Toyota Arena in Ontario, California, Sami Zayn addressed the crowd alongside Johnny Gargano and Candice LeRae. Zayn discussed the misconception that the alpha male must be the biggest and strongest, instead stressing that the smart one survives, and declared he would not tolerate disrespect from anyone including Penta. Rey Fenix then interrupted, noting uncertainty over Penta's actions while affirming that he and Zayn remain family but warning of consequences if Zayn disrespects that family. The show opened with a recap of Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn's argument on Raw as the road to Crown Jewel continues.

items.title: The Miz Recalls Early Locker Room Backlash After First WWE Tag Title Victory
items.summary: The Miz explained on WWE Vault that he and John Morrison drew heat from the locker room on the night they captured their first WWE tag team championships. After cutting loose on commentary during an ECW taping that preceded SmackDown, the duo was instructed to celebrate wildly upon winning the titles, which clashed with the planned focus on the opposing team. This excitement, especially as it marked Miz's initial WWE gold, further upset veterans who already viewed his Tough Enough background skeptically.
items.raw_title: The Miz Recalls Upsetting WWE Locker Room On The Day Of First Tag Title Win
items.src_summary: Among the many issues between The Miz and the WWE locker room early in his career, the wrestler recalled "ruffling feathers" on the night he won the tag title.

kind.quote: We used to shoot 'ECW' before 'SmackDown,' and so me and John Morrison went on ECW — I think it was a CM Punk match — and we went on commentary and we just ripped it apart, and people were upset about that.

items.title: Zack Sabre Jr. Recalls Shibata's 2021 NJPW Return Reaction
items.summary: During the 2021 G1 Climax, Zack Sabre Jr. faced Katsuyori Shibata in an exhibition match on day 19. Shibata had not appeared in NJPW since 2017. While appearing on CMLL’s Esto es Lucha Podcast, Sabre Jr. described the silent audience gasp when Shibata’s music hit under COVID restrictions as unlike anything he had experienced before and said it showed the power of pro wrestling.
items.raw_title: Zack Sabre Jr. Reflects On Exhibition Match Against Katsuyori Shibata, Says He's Never Experienced Anything Like That Reaction To Shibata
items.src_summary: Zack Sabre Jr. looks back on the exhibition. On day 19 of the 2021 New Japan Pro-Wrestling G1 Climax tournament, an exhibition match took place, and one of the participants was Zack Sabre Jr.

kind.quote: I’ve never experienced anything like the silent gasp of when the first bars of his theme music played where it was like, I felt in sync with the audience. That epitomized the power of pro wrestling.

items.title: Charlotte Flair Says Vulnerability Boosts Her Strength
items.summary: WWE star Charlotte Flair discussed the pressure of being Ric Flair's daughter and how it led to a decade as a villain with a disconnect from fans. After tearing her knee two years ago, she realized that embracing vulnerability makes her more powerful and resilient. This approach was the focus of her Player's Tribune article, allowing her to separate her on-screen character from real-life Ashley Fliehr and connect with audiences on a deeper level.
items.raw_title: WWE's Charlotte Flair: 'Being Vulnerable Makes You Powerful'
items.src_summary: WWE star Charlotte Flair opened up on how embracing vulnerability allowed her to connect with fans better.

kind.quote: Being vulnerable is what makes you powerful and resilient and strong

items.title: Leon Slater Says Option C Promo Made Him TNA's Top Guy
items.summary: Leon Slater defeated Cedric Alexander in a Last Man Standing Steel Cage match to win the TNA X Division Title at Lockdown. He then exercised Option C to challenge for Nic Nemeth's TNA World Title. Speaking on the I Love Wrestling Podcast, Slater said the Option C promo was the moment he transitioned from being seen as a kid to becoming the guy in TNA, with his Bound for Glory follow-up solidifying it further.
items.raw_title: Leon Slater Feels Like His Option C Promo At TNA Lockdown Was The Moment He Became 'The Guy' In TNA
items.src_summary: Leon Slater comments on his Option C promo at TNA Lockdown. On the show, Leon Slater competed in a Last Man Standing Steel Cage match for the TNA X Division Title. He defeated Cedric Alexander to become the new champion.

kind.quote: Yeah, absolutely. I think it’s rare that we get these pinpoint moments in wrestling. I’m not comparing here but just to use an analogy, the Austin 3:16 promo for example. You can point to that moment and you go, ‘Yeah, that’s when he became who he is.’ I feel like, for me, in my TNA run, the moment of me cashing in Option C was like, ‘Leon’s not the kid anymore. He is the guy now.’

items.title: Leon Slater Calls TNA World Title Reign Surreal
items.summary: Leon Slater became the youngest TNA World Champion in history after defeating Nic Nemeth at Bound for Glory, achieving the feat five years ahead of his own prediction. In a recent interview, the 22-year-old described how it took time to sink in that the title was his, noting he initially felt like he was carrying Nemeth's belt. Slater added that he still lives at home and recently had the championship on his TV table while playing GTA with friends, struggling to process the reality.
items.raw_title: Leon Slater Says TNA World Championship Is 'Finally Beginning To Feel Mine'
items.src_summary: Leon Slater comments on his TNA World Championship reign. At TNA Bound for Glory, Leon Slater defeated Nic Nemeth and became the youngest TNA World Champion in the company’s history. He accomplished his goal five years earlier than he predicted.

kind.quote: It feels very surreal, man. It took a while for it to settle in because I kind of felt like I was carrying Nic Nemeth’s belt around for a while just because I’ve so used to seeing him with it.

Remsburg believes the stadium would be in the conversation for a domestic All In but does not expect it to happen in 2027.

items.src_summary: Lincoln Financial Field hosting the event is a possibility. In September 2026, Fightful Select reported that the general feeling from those connected to AEW is that the 2027 installment of All In will take place in North America in some form.

kind.quote: if we were looking for a domestic stadium to host All In at, I do think The Linc would be in the conversation.

items.title: Kevin Nash Recalls Shawn Michaels Hospital Angle
items.summary: Kevin Nash pitched a detailed angle where Shawn Michaels sold a serious injury after taking a blow in a match. The plan involved both heels and babyfaces coming from the locker room to stand around Michaels before he was taken out on a stretcher. Nash said they checked Michaels into a Springfield hospital as part of the storyline, leading fans to call the facility seeking updates on his condition.
items.raw_title: Kevin Nash Remembers WWE's Shawn Michaels Checking Into Hospital To Sell A Storyline
items.src_summary: Hall of Famer Kevin Nash recalls how well Shawn Michaels did on selling a hospital visit for a WWE storyline.

kind.quote: I remember when we did the Shawn Michaels thing, when he took the blow and he went down, and I remember when I pitched it, I said, 'We can't have the commentators talk...We have to have the locker rooms come out, heels and babyfaces, kind of standing to make sure that he's f***ed, and then take him out...' I'm pretty sure we checked him into a Springfield hospital. So, people called. Shawn was in the hospital. So...you can make s*** real. But you can't make s*** half real.

items.title: Drew McIntyre Compares WWE Leadership Styles
items.summary: Drew McIntyre discussed working under both Vince McMahon and Triple H in WWE. He described McMahon as viewing things in black and white with simpler good guy versus bad guy dynamics while seeing Triple H as operating in shades of gray more reflective of the real world. McIntyre cited the Bloodline storyline as inspiration for his own character shift in 2022 from heroic Scottish Warrior to a more nuanced antagonist.
items.raw_title: WWE's Drew McIntyre Details Change In Leadership From Vince McMahon To Triple H
items.src_summary: Drew McIntyre believes Triple H has a more realistic take on WWE's creative direction compared to Vince McMahon.

kind.quote: In 2022, we really started going from Drew the Big Hero of Covid, the Scottish Warrior, to going down the path of becoming a bad guy.

items.title: Eric Bischoff Credits DDP's Authenticity For Getting Over In WCW
items.summary: On his "83 Weeks" podcast, WWE Hall of Famer Eric Bischoff disagreed with Diamond Dallas Page's belief that the Diamond Cutter finisher is what made him popular in WCW. Bischoff praised the move but said Page truly connected with fans when he dropped the larger-than-life character and became authentic as Page Falkinburg. Bischoff noted that Page's earlier gimmicks were forgettable and that being himself propelled him to the height of his popularity.
items.raw_title: WWE HOFer Eric Bischoff Disagrees With How Diamond Dallas Page Got Over In WCW
items.src_summary: According to Eric Bischoff, it was a simplification of Dallas Page's onscreen persona that won him over with fans, rather than his finishing move.

kind.quote: It's not what got him over. What got him over was when he became Page Falkinburg; when he allowed himself to go out and be authentic.

items.title: Michael Hayes Recalls Hiding From André The Giant
items.summary: While recounting his career, Michael Hayes described an incident where André the Giant was set to agent a show in Ohio featuring The Freebirds. After Hayes partied heavily the night before and needed to be carried into the building, the group later tried to avoid André at an airport by hiding behind a pillar. Hayes explained they were afraid because he had already been in trouble for showing up unprepared the first time André served as agent.
items.raw_title: Michael Hayes Recounts André The Giant Agenting Matches
items.src_summary: Michael Hayes discusses André. The latest episode of Stephanie McMahon's What's Your Story? podcast featured an extensive chat with WWE producer Michael Hayes. As they were going over Hayes' life and pro wrestling career, Hayes brought up that André the Giant agented matches.

kind.quote: We got up the next morning and there was a flight to New Haven or something and there was a flight to Atlanta, and it didn’t take long and all of a sudden, we’re changing our flights and here comes André, and we hid, all three of us are hiding behind this pillar, like, ‘I hope he don’t see us. Please don’t see us.’

items.title: Michael Hayes Heartbroken After Split From Hardys
items.summary: In 1999 Michael P.S. Hayes managed The Hardys and was in their corner when they won their first WWF Tag Team Championship. He was removed from the group in August 1999 after Vince McMahon decided Hayes was too harsh on Matt and Jeff following their title loss. While speaking to Stephanie McMahon on the What’s Your Story? podcast, Hayes said the decision broke his heart because he had become invested in the role.
items.raw_title: Michael Hayes States That He Was Heartbroken When He Was Split From The Hardys In WWE
items.src_summary: Michael Hayes was invested in the duo. In the year 1999, current WWE producer Michael P.S.

kind.quote: It was funny. Once they dropped the titles, I was specifically told and produced to tell them they’re going back to the starting box and going back to foundation and you’re beginning at the beginning and you would start over and earn it and be a real tyrant, and then Vince (McMahon) goes, ‘God! He can’t be like that to those kids. They should beat him up. Why is he being so mean? Nobody would listen to that. No, get him away from them,’ and then when he told me that, it broke my heart.

items.title: Angel Medina Retires From Wrestling
items.summary: Angel Medina, known as Angel of Da Baldies in ECW, wrestled his final match on October 24 at FLEX Wrestling in New York. He lost to HC Loc in a bout officiated by his former tag partner Tony DeVito after feuding with Loc throughout the year. Medina debuted in 1996, joined ECW in 1998 as Spanish Angel, competed regularly until 2019, returned for a few bouts in 2024, and is a six-time IWA Puerto Rico Hardcore Champion.

items.title: JBL Recalls Curt Hennig Drugging Drinks on Plane Ride From Hell
items.summary: On an episode of "Something to Wrestle," John Bradshaw Layfield discussed the wild culture of the 1990s and early 2000s wrestling scene. He revealed that spiking drinks, referred to as "gimmicking," was a common prank among wrestlers at the time and occurred during the infamous Plane Ride from Hell. items.raw_title: JBL Recalls WWE HOFer Spiking Drinks During Infamous 'Plane Ride From Hell'

kind.quote: I saw it, yes. Yeah, absolutely, Plane Ride from Hell. [Hennig] gimmicked [Jim Ross] and he gimmicked [Gerald] Brisco.

items.title: JBL Explains Why Vince McMahon Refused To Turn John Cena Heel
items.summary: John Bradshaw Layfield said Vince McMahon refused to turn John Cena heel because he had previously turned Stone Cold Steve Austin heel and watched Austin's merchandise sales suffer as a result. JBL recalled sitting in multiple meetings where the idea of Cena turning heel was raised only for McMahon to immediately reject it. Cena remained WWE's top babyface throughout McMahon's tenure and only worked as a heel after TKO took over.
items.raw_title: JBL: Vince McMahon Never Turned John Cena Heel In WWE Due To Previous Lesson Learned

kind.quote: You wonder why they never turned Cena? 'Cause they turned [Stone Cold Steve] Austin, and Austin was, the merch that Austin – Steve – was selling was ridiculous, and Vince learned his lesson.

items.title: Jake Hager Faces Possible More Eye Surgery
items.summary: Former WWE and AEW performer Jake Hager required emergency surgery after suffering a ruptured eye from a powerful slap in the second round of his Power Slap 23 bout against independent wrestler Johnny Magna in Lubbock, Texas. The match ended in a referee stoppage victory for Magna after Hager's team argued for a foul call. items.summary: In an interview with Fightful, Alice Crowley discussed being added to the 2026 CMLL Women's Grand Prix field. kind.quote: I can’t even put into words, you know; it’s the same thing. I just, I can’t believe Scott picked me out of everyone else on the roster honestly, and it’s not because I think that I don’t work hard enough for it, but it’s just because our roster is made up of such talented women and so many women, who have been all over the country already, and just think that a position like this would be given to somebody of a higher ranking but I think Scott is the type of person to give everybody a chance and I think he sees something in me that I see in myself and we’re gonna show it to the world here in Mexico.

items.title: Killer Kross Recalls WWE Merger Promise For Acting Opportunities
items.summary: Killer Kross recalled a meeting held inside WWE a couple of years ago where executives discussed how the upcoming merger with TKO would create pathways into other areas of the entertainment industry. He described the session as similar to a university lecture and said the company appeared to take the subject seriously. Kross later followed up with WWE about his theater background and interest in acting while making it clear he did not want to stop wrestling.
items.raw_title: Former WWE Star Killer Kross Recalls Failed Entertainment Industry Promise From TKO
items.src_summary: Former WWE star Killer Kross (previously known as Karrion Kross) had inquired about getting more involved in Hollywood after a company-wide meeting.

kind.quote: A couple of years ago, we had this in-house meeting at WWE where, you know, the bosses were there and they were talking about how the merger with TKO was going to provide some sort of transitionary connective tissue into getting into different types of lanes of entertainment.

items.title: Tony Schiavone Says AEW Often Builds Shows With Minimal Prep
items.summary: AEW commentator Tony Schiavone said on his What Happened When? podcast that the company sometimes assembles its shows with not that much prep. He noted that he and fellow commentators often learn about changes at the same time as the wrestlers and fans. Schiavone credited much of AEW's early success to the roster's ability to work on the fly and pull together strong shows despite limited preparation.
items.raw_title: Tony Schiavone reveals AEW sometimes puts shows together with ‘not that much prep’
items.src_summary: AEW commentator Tony Schiavone recently discussed how AEW shows are put together, revealing on his What Happened When?

kind.quote: I really think that’s one of the reasons for our (AEW’s) success, because we have A lot of people that can work on the fly, and a lot of people that can pull together a great show with sometimes not that much prep.

items.title: Tony Schiavone Recalls Having Doubts About Clockwork Carnage
items.summary: AEW commentator Tony Schiavone admitted on his What Happened When podcast that he was concerned beforehand whether the Clockwork Carnage match at WrestleDream would work on pay-per-view. He said the participants had meetings about the concept but still did not know what to expect going in. Schiavone ultimately felt the match delivered strong drama and called it very good.
items.raw_title: Tony Schiavone admits backstage concern over new AEW match concept
items.src_summary: AEW commentator Tony Schiavone recently discussed the Clockwork Carnage match from AEW WrestleDream, explaining how he was concerned that the match concept might not work on PPV in practice.

kind.quote: I didn’t know what to expect [from the match]. Nobody did, nobody. We’re in the back, we’ve had meetings, we’ve been told what’s going to go on…but we still didn’t know what to expect, and I’m thinking ‘this could really not turn out too good.’ But I thought it was good. I thought it was very good, and I thought there was a lot of drama.

items.title: Wren Sinclair Praises Total Divas Impact
items.summary: Wren Sinclair discussed her love for reality television and explained how WWE's Total Divas was important because it highlighted the women wrestlers and allowed fans to learn more about their personalities and personal lives when that was often missing from the main TV shows. Sinclair mentioned growing up watching programs like Keeping Up with the Kardashians and Bad Girls Club, and noted that the show made her feel like she was getting to know the performers on a deeper level, such as visiting Natalya's home.

kind.quote: I feel like it highlighted the women sometimes when the television didn’t. It allowed you to get a grasp of what they actually go through.

items.title: Grayson Waller Shares Shawn Michaels' Reaction To NXT Pipebomb

kind.quote: And it’s funny because I said to Shawn [Michaels] before I went out, ‘I hope one of these kids comes and says something to me. That’s what we want.’ And Shawn said, ‘I hope one of these kids slaps you.’ And he meant that.

items.title: Saudi Airport Attack Kills One Ahead of WWE Crown Jewel
items.summary: King Fahd International Airport in Dammam was hit on Wednesday night, resulting in one death and eight injuries along with property damage according to the General Authority of Civil Aviation. The eastern Saudi city has seen multiple attacks in recent weeks claimed by the Iran-backed Houthis, coming days before Riyadh hosts Canelo Alvarez versus Christian Mbilli on October 31 and WWE Crown Jewel the following week. Riyadh International Airport has faced heavy restrictions after prior incidents including one that killed 13 and injured over 300.

items.title: Dominik Mysterio Eyes Multiple WWE Titles
items.summary: Dominik Mysterio recently lost the AAA MEGA Championship to El Grand Americano at TripleMania. In a Bleacher Report interview, he discussed potential targets including the World Heavyweight Championship held by Roman Reigns, the WWE Title involving Sami Zayn and Kevin Owens, his former Intercontinental Championship and the tag team titles alongside JD.
items.raw_title: Dominik Mysterio Discusses Current Title Aspirations In WWE
items.src_summary: Dominik Mysterio has discussed the various championships in WWE and his chances if he chose to go after them, including tag titles. Since AAA TripleMania, Mysterio has been without a championship belt after losing the MEGA Championship to El Grand Americano at the event.

kind.quote: There’s a lot of things I’d like to get done. I got some beef with Roman. He tried to throw me out of the ring and end my career one time. Sami Zayn, on the other hand, we’ve got a lot of history with Sami and Kevin in The Judgment Day, so maybe there’s something over there with the WWE title on the line. Maybe I want my IC title back. Maybe I wanna go for the tag titles with JD, get him some gold too. Who knows? There’s a lot of things I’d like to get done, but we’re taking it one day at a time.

items.title: Ilja Dragunov Calls Emotional Expression Wrestling's Toughest Element
items.summary: Ilja Dragunov explained that the most draining aspect of pro wrestling is the expressive side, including vocality, facial expressions and audience engagement. He noted this is often harder than performing physical moves, as it requires constant focus on reacting authentically to the action and involving the crowd throughout a match. The comments come from a recent interview reported by Fightful Select.
items.raw_title: Ilja Dragunov Says That The Expressive Part Of Wrestling Is 'The Real Exhausting Part'
items.src_summary: Ilja Dragunov says that the expressive part of wrestling is 'the real exhausting part' of the industry noting that it is harder than moves.

kind.quote: It is definitely the part of expressing yourself. It is the vocality. It is the expressions. This part of portraying what you’re doing is at times much harder than any move that you can do.

items.title: Jaxson Ryker details severe injuries after WWE exit
items.summary: Former WWE star Jaxson Ryker discussed his 2023 retirement from wrestling, citing a neck injury and lower-back injury that caused arm and hand numbness along with extreme pain. He noted that his body was in bad shape following his 2021 WWE release, which led him to pursue other opportunities rather than continue. Ryker said he had long planned to walk away if wrestling stopped being enjoyable or his body hurt too badly, and he made a brief independent run before retiring.
items.raw_title: Former WWE star reveals ‘excruciating pain’ after release and lower back injury that caused arm numbness
items.src_summary: Former WWE star Jaxson Ryker opened up about his decision to step away from wrestling, revealing the persistent injuries and body aches that contributed to it. Ryker emphasized the toll of wrestling on his body following his WWE release in 2021.

kind.quote: My body, when I got released from WWE, my body was hurting real bad. I’d had a neck injury and a lower-back injury that was causing some numbness in my arm and my hand. Just really, really excruciating pain for the most part.

items.title: Ilja Dragunov Shares Emotional AEW WrestleDream Entrance
items.summary: Ilja Dragunov discussed how meaningful his entrance at AEW WrestleDream was to him. He highlighted the return of the music from the start of his career that accompanied his most memorable indie moments along with the arena atmosphere and the detailed effort AEW put into the presentation. Dragunov faces Speedball Mike Bailey in his first AEW match.
items.raw_title: Ilja Dragunov Reflects On Entrance At AEW WrestleDream: "Something That I Possibly Will Carry In My Heart For The Rest Of My Life"
items.src_summary: Ilja Dragunov speaks about his debut. The 2026 All Elite Wrestling WrestleDream pay-per-view featured the debut of Ilja Dragunov. He is making the media rounds ahead of his in-ring debut for the company and appeared on TMZ's Inside The Ring podcast.

kind.quote: This entrance already meant the world for me. The music that I had is the music that I had in the beginning of my career. To have this back means everything to me because my most memorable moments were all connected to that, in my humble indie days, and just the atmosphere of the arena, the warm welcoming of the people, the entire world that AEW put into that detail by detail and the devotion of working together on that and making this beautiful day, this beautiful beginning possible is something that I possibly will carry in my heart for the rest of my life.

items.title: Christopher Daniels Saw Greatness In AJ Styles From First Match
items.summary: Christopher Daniels told Going Ringside that the first time he faced AJ Styles was at the NWA 53rd anniversary tournament before TNA existed. Daniels said he could tell that day Styles was going to be something special. Once TNA launched, Styles was there from the start, won the world title within his first year, and went on to a career Daniels considers Hall of Fame worthy.

kind.quote: You could tell that day that he was going to be something special.

items.title: AJ Francis Praises Carlos Silva's TNA Leadership
items.summary: AJ Francis told The Wrestling Classic that Carlos Silva has a modern, sports-like leadership style in TNA that acknowledges talent right in front of him. Francis noted it has been nearly two years since he last held a championship in the promotion and said Silva recognizes that fact unlike previous regimes. He contrasted Silva's approach with the old wrestling style of ignoring established performers in favor of pushing newer ones.
items.raw_title: Former WWE star says Carlos Silva recognizes his value amid two-year TNA championship absence
items.src_summary: AJ Francis praised Carlos Silva’s leadership capabilities in TNA while expressing he knows his value and contributions to the promotion. Speaking with Justin Dhillon of The Wrestling Classic, Francis discussed the change in TNA’s leadership style with Silva at the helm.

kind.quote: His leadership style is more so of real sports. He doesn’t ignore what’s right in front of his face.

items.title: Ilja Dragunov Discusses Ongoing Panic Attacks in Matches
items.summary: Ilja Dragunov told Ariel Helwani that he experiences panic attacks during wrestling matches on a regular basis. He explained that while he once tried to eliminate them, he now accepts the feeling as part of his life because it also drives him to perform with greater intensity, effort and love for the work. Dragunov added that the attacks happen multiple times per week but he no longer focuses on them.
items.raw_title: Ilja Dragunov opens up about experiencing panic attacks during wrestling matches
items.src_summary: Ilja Dragunov recently revealed that suffering panic attacks during his wrestling matches has become a consistent occurrence in his career. Recently, speaking to Ariel Helwani on The Ariel Helwani Show, Dragunov opened up about his experience with panic attacks. “I still have that.

kind.quote: I still have that. Sometimes I have this very bad, sometimes I have it less, but it’s a consistent thing that is kind of a part of my life.

items.title: Roman Reigns Shares Advice For Young WWE Talent
items.summary: Roman Reigns discussed the guidance he offers younger WWE performers while promoting his upcoming film Street Fighter. He emphasized the importance of developing signature moves that become integral to the show so audiences look forward to seeing them. Reigns is enjoying a strong run after winning the 2026 Royal Rumble, defeating CM Punk for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania 42 and defending against Jacob Fatu, LA Knight, Penta and Seth Rollins at SummerSlam.
items.raw_title: Roman Reigns Reveals Advice He Shares With Younger WWE Stars

kind.quote: With WWE, your signature moves become a part of the show, and we preach that to the younger guys, like 'Make sure you find out these signatures and make them a part of our program, so people want to see them.'

items.title: AEW's Pac Dies at 40 in Illinois Parking Lot
items.summary: AEW wrestler Benjamin Satterley, who performed as Pac, was found unresponsive in his vehicle in a Des Plaines, Illinois restaurant parking lot on September 27. He was pronounced dead at age 40. His wife Natalie Taylor called his phone while authorities were on scene and told them she had spoken to him less than three hours earlier as he planned to stop at the CAVA eatery before heading to O'Hare Airport.

She shared that visiting Ripley's home and meeting her dogs, which are treated like babies by Ripley and her husband, has turned her into a dog person. AEW World Champion Will Ospreay faced Ricochet in a match filled with nods to PAC's moveset, culminating in Ospreay hitting the Black Arrow to score the pinfall. Ospreay later told Real Radio Monsters that delivering the AEW locker room one final Black Arrow meant more to him than any world championship.

items.title: Will Ospreay Says Wrestling Has Evolved Past Full Kayfabe
items.summary: Will Ospreay believes professional wrestling in 2026 has moved beyond the need for complete kayfabe protection. He pointed to shows like WWE: Unreal and AEW: All Access that explore backstage elements while noting some aspects still require safeguarding. Ospreay compared the experience to watching superhero films where audiences accept the story without demanding protection of the business.
items.raw_title: Will Ospreay Feels Wrestling As 'Evolved' Past Needing Full Kayfabe Protection

kind.quote: I mean it can still be done to this day and age for sure. It can be, but just like, I think, you don’t go into like a cinema. I like the Avengers and like Spider-Man and I love Batman. I don’t go into those things and instantly just go, well, ‘they’re not protecting the business.’

items.title: Kevin Nash hails Oba Femi as WWE's next major star
items.summary: Kevin Nash singled out Oba Femi as the wrestler with the most momentum in WWE, describing him as having a rocket strapped to him. Nash noted that Femi has refined his entrance from an exaggerated, cartoony style to a cooler version after just a few steps. He also pointed to Femi's recent ring exchange with Paul Heyman where he rejected being the next Heyman guy and referenced Bron Breakker, saying the moment showed Femi's growing confidence and that he will continue improving.

items.title: Ilja Dragunov Explains Facing Brock Lesnar at Royal Rumble
items.summary: During an interview on The Ariel Helwani Show, AEW's Ilja Dragunov reflected on his brief 2024 Royal Rumble encounter with Brock Lesnar. Dragunov noted that his established persona involves battling monsters and that most people would flee from someone like Lesnar. He explained that he stayed true to his mentally and physically tough character despite Lesnar no-selling his offense before eliminating him, adding that his character has always centered on vulnerability.

kind.quote: If you really understand the persona that I have been in the ring most of the time, like, I've been facing monsters.

items.title: Cody Rhodes Praises WWE's Top Pay Scale
items.summary: Cody Rhodes shared comments from WWE President Nick Khan about the company's tiered pay structure during an interview. items.title: Judge lets WWE Ring Boys lawsuit proceed
items.summary: A federal judge in Maryland denied the latest motion to dismiss the child sexual abuse case filed by multiple plaintiffs against Vince McMahon, Linda McMahon, WWE, and TKO. The 26-page opinion upheld the constitutionality of the state's Child Victims Act of 2023, which removed statutes of limitations for childhood sexual abuse claims. The plaintiffs are represented by DiCello Levitt and Murphy, Falcon & Murphy.

items.title: Kyle Fletcher Watches Back Every Match

The Australian star uses the self-review as a key part of his feedback process, watching each bout objectively as a finished product so he can identify improvements and apply them going forward. Fletcher has become one of AEW's top in-ring performers over the past two years and is now regarded as one of the best wrestlers worldwide.
items.raw_title: Kyle Fletcher: I Try And Watch Every Single Match Of Mine Back
items.src_summary: Kyle Fletcher shares that he tries to watch every single matches he participates in back to take feedback and apply it to himself. kind.quote: Yeah. I try and watch every single match of mine back. I think it’s a very important part of the feedback loop, being able to watch myself objectively removed from it and look at it as a finished product and be able to take that feedback and apply it to myself.

items.title: Cody Rhodes Names His Favorite Dusty Promo
items.summary: Cody Rhodes revealed that his favorite Dusty Rhodes promo is not the widely celebrated "Hard Times" but rather a 1994 WCW segment with brother Dustin titled "The View Never Changes." In it Dusty addressed neglecting Dustin and expressed a desire to become his tag team partner. Cody explained that the family has lived much of their story publicly and that the heartfelt promo served as Dusty's way of apologizing and saying he loved his son.

items.title: Anthony Bowens Explains His Post-Acclaimed AEW Storyline
items.summary: Anthony Bowens discussed his character arc after the Acclaimed's run in AEW. He noted the return was intentionally structured to lead into his heel turn where he blamed Billy Gunn and the fans while developing the Pride of Pro Wrestling persona. Bowens added that he channeled real emotions into the role and is currently aligned with The Opps.
items.raw_title: Anthony Bowens Says Everything After AEW Acclaimed Run Happened How It Was Supposed To

kind.quote: They think the return was a flop, which it wasn't. It was made to be that way so I could go off the deep end, blame Billy for my not being able to win the big matches, blame the fans for choosing Caster over me, adding to his delusion of being the best wrestler alive. And then I would go into what the Pride of Pro Wrestling was.

items.title: William Regal Urges Wrestlers To Sell Pins And Kickouts Better
items.summary: WWE veteran William Regal advised wrestlers to treat every pin attempt and kick-out with maximum intensity as if their career depended on it. He pointed to an early 2000s match between AJ Styles and Amazing Red as the ideal example where both men covered shoulders fully and exploded out with force. Regal stressed that this approach respects the audience's time and maintains the realism of the pro wrestling story.
items.raw_title: WWE's William Regal: Wrestlers Should Pay More Attention To Pin Attempts & Kick-Outs
items.src_summary: 42-year industry veteran William Regal offers valuable advice about wrestling pin attempts and kick-outs.

kind.quote: We are portraying trained pro fighters with instincts. If you don't win you would make less money in the story we're telling. Please pin and kick out like your life and career depend on it.

items.title: Cody Rhodes Links Neck Tattoo To Career Rise
items.summary: Cody Rhodes got his neck tattoo after leaving New Japan Pro-Wrestling's Bullet Club because he wanted his own distinct logo instead of the faction's gun design. The American Nightmare logo draws from the Street Fighter villain M. Bison and Shadaloo, an idea he gave the artist after seeing it in a Burlesque Hall scene. Rhodes debuted the tattoo at AEW Revolution 2020, returned to WWE in 2022, and has held the Undisputed WWE Championship three times since.

items.title: Cena Ate Hornswoggle's Vomit-Covered Burger After Missed Flight
items.summary: John Cena, Christian Cage and Hornswoggle were stranded in Ireland due to a volcano preventing their return for a WWE Raw episode. After a night of heavy drinking, Hornswoggle vomited on his room service hamburger, which Christian placed in the hallway after putting him to bed. Hours later a hungry Cena found the untouched-looking burger and ate it, only learning the truth from the pair the next morning.
items.raw_title: A Missed WWE Flight In Ireland Led To Hornswoggle Vomiting On John Cena's Hamburger
items.src_summary: Having an incredible WWE career, the "Never Seen 17" star John Cena recalls an unforgettable night that did not end in his favor.

kind.quote: We got stuck in Ireland because there was a volcano and we couldn't get back to the states to perform [on] '[WWE] Raw.'

items.title: Chad Gable Remembers WWE Match Against Kurt Angle
items.summary: Chad Gable described his match with Kurt Angle on Monday Night Raw as a dream come true. The bout took place in Chicago near his home state of Minnesota and the pair were given extra time in a rare occurrence under Vince McMahon's era allowing them to wrestle on the fly. Gable said it was a wonderful night except for receiving a speeding ticket on the drive home.
items.raw_title: Chad Gable Recalls WWE Match With Kurt Angle, Getting Pulled Over Afterwards
items.src_summary: WWE Intercontinental Champion Chad Gable recalls his lone singles match with Kurt Angle in 2019, revealing that he was pulled over for speeding after

kind.quote: The cool thing I do remember about that is, in a very rare occurrence on a 'Monday Night Raw' live, we actually ended up getting more time than we were supposed to, in the moment. So we just got to wrestle. And to be able to just go in there and just be wrestling on the fly, winging it with Kurt Angle of all people, it's like 'This is happening?' And this is in Chicago, which is great, the crowd is always great. It was a great night man, except I got a speeding ticket on the way home.

items.title: Will Ospreay Would Run Underground Wrestling If Banned
items.summary: Will Ospreay told WKMG News 6 that he is extremely grateful for his current spot in pro wrestling. The AEW star recalled starting out wrestling in his backyard on a trampoline and in other backyard promotions before receiving formal training. Ospreay added that his passion is so strong that if wrestling were made illegal he would continue by running a secret mafia-style underground promotion.
items.raw_title: Will Ospreay: If Wrestling Became Illegal Tomorrow, I'd Be Like The Criminal Mastermind Of An Underground Mafia Wrestling Promotion
items.src_summary: Will Ospreay discusses his adoration for the pro wrestling industry, noting how far he would go to remain a pro wrestler.

kind.quote: I’m so blessed to be able to be in this position, to be able to just do something that… I love doing, like I’ve said it so many times, if wrestling became like illegal tomorrow, like I’d be in my garden wrestling. Like I’d happily, like I’d be like the criminal mastermind of like an underground, Mafia wrestling run promotion.

items.summary: Andrade El Idolo retained the AEW National Title against Tommaso Ciampa at WrestleDream. During the press conference Tony Khan addressed the comedy spot where Ciampa pulled his opponent's pants down, comparing it to the style of taunting Orange Cassidy uses while remaining a serious competitor.

items.title: AEW WrestleDream Takeaways Include Clockwork Carnage Innovation
items.summary: AEW CEO Tony Khan introduced the new Clockwork Carnage match concept at WrestleDream where Will Ospreay retained the Men's World Championship by defeating Adam Copeland with a last-second Hidden Blade. Mike Bailey was eliminated first while Kazuchika Okada eliminated Konosuke Takeshita before the lead changed hands rapidly in the second phase. Following the bout Copeland announced 2027 as his final year in wrestling and the two had a tense post-match handshake with Samoa Joe watching from the stage as AEW heads toward Blood and Guts.

items.title: Ilja Dragunov Calls WrestleDream Crowd Reaction Overwhelming
items.summary: Fresh off his AEW debut at WrestleDream, Ilja Dragunov described the audience response as very overwhelming and a breath of fresh air in his new environment. He expressed that the welcome he received felt completely right. Per Fightful Select, the former WWE star chose free agency in 2026 rather than re-signing with the company.

items.src_summary: Ilja Dragunov speaks about his AEW debut. After signing with All Elite Wrestling and debuting at the 2026 WrestleDream pay-per-view, Ilja Dragunov joined Renee Paquette and AEW President Tony Khan for the post-event media scrum.

kind.quote: I would say very, very overwhelming. It’s a new breath of fresh air for me. It is a totally new environment for me. But the way I’ve got welcomed here, it only feels plainly right.

items.title: Andrade Explains 2023 AEW Exit For Personal Reasons
items.summary: Andrade El Idolo left AEW in 2023 to join WWE so he could be with his then-wife Charlotte Flair, prioritizing his personal life over his professional contract which had expired. He thanked Tony Khan for the initial opportunity and expressed hope to return one day. After leaving WWE in September 2025 following their divorce, Andrade returned to AEW and is now motivated to repay the second chance by defending his title, helping the locker room and representing the company strongly.
items.raw_title: Andrade El Idolo Explains Why He Left AEW In 2023

items.summary: David Finlay decided at age 15 that he wanted to pursue professional wrestling. items.summary: Matt Hardy analyzed Tiffany Stratton's Swanton bomb attempt from the top of a tall ladder during the women's Money in the Bank ladder match. items.title: Will Ospreay Grateful For Kicking Out Of One Winged Angel

In a recent interview, Ospreay expressed that earning Omega's trust with the moment elevated him to legendary status and left him extremely grateful.

kind.quote: That I won Kenny’s trust, because a lot of that comes down to how much he wants to protect it and going forward, like where… Where does that put me? It just elevates me up to like a legendary status that I will never fully be able to express my gratitude for having that type of moment with someone that I do generally look at as like a hero of mine. So to have that was just out of this world, mind blowing. Like I’m just super grateful for it.

items.summary: Maria Kanellis explained on Insight With Chris Van Vliet how the Laurel Van Ness wedding storyline in TNA drew WWE's attention to her and Mike Bennett.
