items.title: Adam Copeland Credits AEW For Historic Venue Run
items.summary: Adam Copeland shared that returning to WWE in 2020 made him doubt he'd ever wrestle in his dream venues like Arena Mexico, Wembley Stadium and the Tokyo Dome. After moving to AEW those opportunities opened up, allowing him to perform at Arena Mexico, Wembley Stadium and Maple Leaf Gardens all within one month. He said these bucket-list experiences are what keep him motivated and fired up during his current run.
items.raw_title: Adam Copeland Explains How Joining AEW Opened The Door To Historic Venues
items.src_summary: AEW star Adam Copeland has stated that his ability to cross certain venues off his bucket list has helped him stay excited about wrestling.

kind.quote: Moving to AEW, then suddenly that became a possibility and now, within one calendar month, to be able to check off Arena Mexico, to be able to check off Wembley Stadium, and now to be able to do Maple Leaf Gardens? That, for me, is just amazing.

items.title: Keanu Carver Set For Court Hearing
items.summary: Keanu Carver, whose real name is Kevin Robertson, is scheduled to appear in Seminole County, Florida court on October 20 for a review of a protective order issued against him. items.title: TNA Impact Viewership Rises Before Bound for Glory
items.summary: The October 8 episode of TNA Impact drew 214,000 viewers on AMC, marking a 17.6 percent increase from the prior week and the highest audience since September 10. items.title: Bandido Surpasses Jay Lethal For Most Combined ROH World Title Days
items.summary: Bandido broke Jay Lethal's record for the most overall days as ROH World Champion on October 14. His two reigns now total more than 710 days combined, passing Lethal's previous mark of 707 days across his 2015-2016 and 2018-2019 title runs. Bandido's current reign, which began at AEW Dynasty in April 2025, stands at 558 days as he targets Samoa Joe's all-time single-reign record of 645 days.
items.raw_title: Bandido Breaks Jay Lethal's Record For Most Overall Days As ROH World Champion
items.src_summary: Bandido breaks a major record. History was made on October 14, as Bandido officially passed Jay Lethal for the most overall days (710+) as the ROH World Champion. This number is spread over two separate reigns, one from 2021 and his current reign, which started at AEW Dynasty in April 2025.

items.title: Bruce Prichard To Have Surgery For Old Neck Injury
items.summary: WWE Hall of Famer Bruce Prichard is scheduled to undergo surgery to repair a broken neck. The injury originated 35 years ago in 1991 when he was attacked by The Ultimate Warrior while portraying Brother Love during a WWF Superstars taping. Prichard only learned of its true severity recently as the condition worsened over time.

items.title: Sheamus Recalls Nervous WWE ECW Debut
items.summary: Sheamus made his official main roster debut on the June 30 2009 episode of ECW defeating Oliver John with a Brogue Kick and backbreaker. The Celtic Warrior admitted feeling extremely nervous early in his WWE run and credited time in developmental plus dark matches for helping him gain confidence before winning the WWE Championship from John Cena less than six months later. He also discussed his reputation as one of the hardest hitters in the business and how he always encouraged opponents to return the physicality because fans want to see a real fight.

items.title: Bully Ray Praises Je'Von Evans' Intense Ambulance Return
items.summary: Bully Ray highlighted a specific moment from the men's Money in the Bank ladder match that stood out more than Je'Von Evans' other spots. After being wheeled away, Evans returned in an ambulance, forcefully opened the door to knock Bron Breakker down, and unloaded with purposeful punches that Ray felt conveyed real intent and made him believe in Evans as a babyface. The WWE Hall of Famer emphasized that the convincing fist strikes and determination shown were more impactful than any other part of the match, proving less is more.

items.title: John Cena Explains Benefits of WWE's PG Era
items.summary: John Cena discussed WWE's shift to a PG rating during an appearance on What Now? With Trevor Noah. He noted the rebranding process took over a decade to gain acceptance and enabled the company to distribute content worldwide since many countries reject PG-13 or MA material. Cena also highlighted how the rise of social media and content creation around 2008 helped elevate wrestlers beyond their previous carny image, leading to massive audience engagement and influence for WWE.

Shawn Michaels and other officials have told him the holdup is purely a matter of timing rather than any shortcomings in his in-ring work.

items.title: Drew McIntyre Slams Pre-Planned Matches
items.summary: WWE star Drew McIntyre criticized wrestlers who map out complete matches beforehand, preferring instead to discuss basics like match length then adapt to the live crowd reaction. He noted that rigidly choreographed bouts often fall flat when audiences respond differently than expected and said many performers today lack the ability to improvise on the fly. McIntyre stressed that panicking during a live broadcast creates an awkward and disjointed feel for everyone involved.
items.raw_title: Drew McIntyre criticizes wrestlers who plan entire matches in advance
items.src_summary: WWE’s Drew McIntyre says he can’t stand wrestlers who plan entire wrestling matches in advance. Speaking on Bradley Martyn’s Raw Talk, McIntyre opened up about his in-ring match psychology and how he prefers to listen to the crowd and perform.

kind.quote: I can’t stand when people plan stuff from beginning to end because you don’t know how the crowd’s going to react.

items.title: Kit Wilson Embraces Growth in WWE Singles Run
items.summary: After his Pretty Deadly partner Elton Prince suffered an injury and stepped away, Kit Wilson transitioned into a singles competitor and has formed an alliance with The Miz. In an interview Wilson described the shift from lifelong tag team wrestler to solo performer as a personal journey that forced him to address weaknesses previously covered by a partner. He stated the experience has helped him mature both as a man and in-ring talent, leaving him better than ever while focused on continued growth.
items.raw_title: Kit Wilson reflects on unexpected challenges of WWE singles career
items.src_summary: Ever since Pretty Deadly member Elton Prince got injured and went on a hiatus, Kit Wilson reinvented himself and emerged as a popular singles wrestler. Currently in a partnership with The Miz, Wilson recently opened up to Denice Salcedo, where he reflected on the challenges of a singles career.

kind.quote: It’s been finding myself. Sometimes art imitates life and life art, and as I go through this change on TV, going from a tag team wrestler- and I was only ever a tag team guy, and I was so committed to that- into this singles journey, it really grows you as a person and you kind of mature with it.

items.title: Zack Gowen Announces Retirement From Wrestling
items.summary: After 24 years in the industry, former WWE performer Zack Gowen has officially retired. He shared a heartfelt message on Facebook thanking promoters, fans, and every major company he worked for, noting that pro wrestling gave purpose to a lost young man. Gowen cited his 2025 one-off AEW match against Ricochet, with family at ringside, as the highlight of his career following his battle with drug addiction featured in Dark Side of the Ring.

items.title: Mike Bailey cherishes emotional Montreal homecoming
items.summary: AEW wrestler Mike Bailey won the International Championship number one contender ladder match at the Redemption event held in his hometown of Montreal. He described the moment as deeply meaningful because it marked the first time his mother attended one of his matches after 20 years in the business, with family members and members of the tight-knit Quebec wrestling community filling the crowd. Bailey recalled standing atop the ladder and seeing familiar faces of relatives and close friends who had surprised him by showing up without telling him in advance.
items.raw_title: AEW star Mike Bailey reflects on emotional homecoming in Montreal
items.src_summary: Mike Bailey recently reflected on his emotional Montreal homecoming during AEW Redemption. Earlier this year, Bailey participated in and won the AEW International Title number one Contender Ladder match at AEW Redemption.

kind.quote: It was absolutely amazing. Not just the fact that I was back home in the arena that I first went to see pro wrestling, but it’s so much closer than that.

items.title: Roman Reigns Explains His Limited Live Event Schedule
items.summary: WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns says his personal schedule will not include more live events despite the company increasing house shows in 2026. He explained that the massive money tied to television rights, weekly shows and premium live events makes it too risky for him to perform at smaller crowds where injury could occur. Reigns added that the reps from live events remain important for honing skills in front of fresh audiences, noting he once wrestled 150-200 times annually early in his career.
items.raw_title: Roman Reigns Comments On WWE Schedule, Says It 'Doesn't Make Sense' To Do Live Events

kind.quote: it doesn't make sense for me to do live events anymore

items.title: Tanea Brooks Named I AM ALS Honorary Board Member
items.summary: Tanea Brooks, known in AEW as Rebel, has been appointed the first-ever Honorary Board Member of I AM ALS after being diagnosed with the disease in May 2024. She has actively advocated for ALS awareness, shared her personal battle on social media, and helped push for the successful reauthorization of the ACT for ALS legislation that extends research funding and treatment access for five years. I AM ALS credited her work as an Ambassador since June for raising visibility and contributing to recent advocacy victories, highlighted by the recent AEW Dynamite: Rebel Heart special.
items.raw_title: Tanea Brooks named first-ever I AM ALS Honorary Board Member

items.title: WWE Seeks United Front For Crown Jewel
items.summary: WWE is pushing for all staff to present a united front regarding the upcoming Crown Jewel event in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia on November 7 despite regional conflicts and travel warnings for American citizens. Construction has begun on the custom Riyadh Seasonal Stadium for the show, which remains scheduled as planned. Several non-wrestling employees have voiced concerns about traveling there, but no wrestlers have spoken out.
items.raw_title: WWE Wants 'United Front' Amidst Crown Jewel Uncertainty
items.src_summary: People in WWE aren't happy about traveling to Saudi Arabia for Crown Jewel 2026, but the company itself wants a "United Front" on the matter.

Bailey expressed his enthusiasm for the complex concept, noting it aligns with his love for intricate match ideas, and views it as his first step toward main eventing an AEW pay-per-view as AEW World Champion.

items.title: Roman Reigns Wishes He Said No More Early In WWE
items.summary: Roman Reigns reflected on his early WWE career and said he would have been more assertive by declining certain promos and segments. The Tribal Chief explained that he lacked the equity at the time to push back while still proving himself in the main event scene. He specifically referenced a 2015 promo with Seth Rollins that fans continue to quote against him years later.
items.raw_title: Roman Reigns Reveals What He'd Go Back And Change About Early WWE Career
items.src_summary: WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns has reflected on his career and revealed what he would have done differently, particularly in its early years.

kind.quote: I probably would have said no a few more times early on, but I didn't have the equity within the company.

items.title: Saudi Airport Hit 20 Times Amid WWE Crown Jewel Prep
items.summary: Saudi officials report that King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh has been targeted by Houthi rebels 20 times in October, resulting in 17 deaths and 333 injuries. The incident comes as WWE prepares for its Crown Jewel 2026 event scheduled at Riyadh Season Stadium on November 7. WWE wrestlers were previously stranded at the same airport for hours after the 2019 Crown Jewel show.
items.raw_title: WWE Crown Jewel host city’s airport targeted 20 times in October, Saudi officials say
items.src_summary: With WWE Crown Jewel 2026 scheduled to take place in Riyadh next month, Saudi officials say King Khalid International Airport in the city has been attacked 20 times this month.

items.title: Bully Ray Defends LA Knight's Announce Table Spot

He explained that the initial struggle made the spot look like a real fight and ultimately drew a massive crowd reaction. Ray added that the subsequent false finish after the table spot received one of the strongest responses in any Reigns match.
items.raw_title: Bully Ray Says 'Absolutely Nothing Went Wrong' With Announce Table Spot At WWE MITB
items.src_summary: WWE legend Bully Ray doesn't think there was anything wrong with LA Knight missing his first attempt at powerbombing Roman Reigns at Money in the Bank.

kind.quote: Nothing went wrong with the announce table spot. Not everything is supposed to be perfect.

items.title: Mick Foley Prefers Tony Khan's Management
items.summary: Mick Foley expressed his strong enjoyment working in AEW and how he connects better with Tony Khan's appreciative management style and supportive board. He noted that WWE remains successful in its own approach but highlighted the benefits of competition, saying AEW has improved pay for WWE wrestlers who now have another option if salaries are reduced. Foley has no regrets leaving WWE and has made sporadic on-screen appearances for AEW in recent months.

items.title: Michael Cole Welcomes CM Punk Back To WWE
items.summary: WWE announcer Michael Cole revealed he and CM Punk were close friends during Punk's first run with the company. After losing touch following Punk's departure, Cole said he was excited about the return, embracing a business-first mentality and stating he was willing to work with him again. items.title: Kaitlyn Rules Out In-Ring Return
items.summary: Former WWE Divas Champion Kaitlyn told Chris Van Vliet she has no desire to wrestle again. The 40-year-old competed in WWE from 2010 to 2014, had a short indie run afterward and made a brief return in the 2018 Mae Young Classic where she lost in the second round to Michin. She expressed deep respect and appreciation for wrestling's artistry, psychology and physical demands but confirmed her retirement is permanent.
items.raw_title: Former WWE champion definitively rules out return and confirms retirement: ‘I don’t have this burning desire’

kind.quote: I don't really want to get back in the ring.

items.title: Kojima can earn NJPW Junior Title Shot with Weight Stipulation
items.summary: NJPW has booked Satoshi Kojima against IWGP Junior Heavyweight Champion YOH at Taichi’s Old School Pro-Wrestling 2 on October 17. The non-title match carries a special condition: if Kojima makes the required weight and defeats YOH, he will receive a future shot at the Junior Heavyweight Championship. The event emanates from Taichi’s former junior high school in Ishikari City, Hokkaido, and will stream live on NJPW World.

items.title: Cody Rhodes Says Ari Emanuel Didn't Know Him Before WrestleMania 40
items.summary: Cody Rhodes revealed that TKO CEO Ari Emanuel was unaware of who he was until Rhodes headlined WrestleMania 40 in 2024. A month after the event Rhodes signed with WME, the agency Emanuel serves as Executive Chairman of, which helped lead to his casting in the upcoming Street Fighter movie alongside Roman Reigns. Rhodes noted he wanted to do right by both Emanuel and his former CAA agent Ari Greenwald, crediting them for establishing him as a serious talent in Hollywood.

items.title: Deonna Purrazzo Credits TNA Run For Building Her Confidence
items.summary: Deonna Purrazzo told The Ledgera that her years in TNA Wrestling shaped her more than any other period in her career. After joining in 2020 at a time when she considered leaving the business, she found a supportive environment that helped her win five world titles, main event multiple shows and lead a division while staying true to herself. The Virginia native previously worked for TNA from 2014-2017 before returning for a second stint that lasted until 2023.
items.raw_title: Deonna Purrazzo: ‘My Time In TNA Gave Me The Confidence To Know I Could Lead A Division And Do It Without Compromising Who I Am And What I Stood For’

kind.quote: My time in TNA/IMPACT shaped me the most.

items.title: Kaitlyn Recalls Unhappy 2014 WWE Exit
items.summary: Kaitlyn explained that her 2014 departure from WWE came after a difficult travel day to Baltimore, the same city where she had debuted years earlier. She was not booked for television, felt deeply unhappy, and asked for her release from Mark Carano in Talent Relations. Carano asked her to sleep on the decision before proceeding.
items.raw_title: Kaitlyn discusses WWE exit in 2014 : ‘I just wanted to be done’
items.src_summary: Former WWE star Kaitlyn opened up about the circumstances that led to her decision to part ways with the company in 2014. Kaitlyn recalled informing Mark Carano, the former VP of Talent Relations, about requesting for her WWE release.

kind.quote: I just wanted to be done

items.title: Eight wrestlers set for AEW Clockwork Carnage title match
items.summary: AEW has finalized the eight-man Clockwork Carnage bout for WrestleDream this Saturday where the winner will be crowned the new AEW World Champion. The participants are defending champion Will Ospreay, Samoa Joe, Speedball Bailey, Adam Copeland, Konosuke Takeshita, Kazuchika Okada, Ricochet and Darby Allin. The final five qualifiers were decided on Wednesday's Dynamite with Takeshita submitting Brian Cage, Okada pinning Myron Reed, Copeland pinning Josh Alexander, Ricochet pinning Ace Austin and Allin defeating Hechicero.

items.summary: CMLL World Heavyweight Champion Hechicero will battle Zack Sabre Jr. in a non-title singles match on the November 16 Lucha Kingdom co-promoted show from Arena Mexico in Mexico City. items.summary: Mini Vikingo won a fatal four-way match on the October 10 episode of Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide by pinning Nobu San with a 630 splash. He advances to face Rey Fenix for the AAA World Cruiserweight Championship at Héroes Inmortales on October 24. The updated card also includes El Grande Americano defending the AAA Mega Championship against Dominik Mysterio and Los Perros del Mal challenging for the AAA World Trios titles.

items.title: FKA Zelina Vega Says Her WWE Look Was Ahead Of Its Time
items.summary: Xelina, the performer previously known as Zelina Vega in WWE, feels her character presentation and physical appearance pushed boundaries that were not yet appreciated during her tenure. She now looks back on that body of work as innovative for the era. The former star continues to reflect positively on her contributions to the promotion.
items.raw_title: FKA Zelina Vega Thinks Her WWE Work Was Ahead Of Its Time

kind.quote: I think my character work was ahead of its time.

items.title: Marcus Mathers Exits WWE ID Program
items.summary: Marcus Mathers has left the WWE ID program after two years. He expressed gratitude for the experience, knowledge gained and connections made while announcing plans to train with various wrestlers and compete across the independent scene. Mathers stated he is now in control of his future and intends to appear everywhere to face any opponent.
items.raw_title: WWE ID DEPARTURE
